description.mn: Acqua di Parma Note di Colonia I: Хүйс харгалзахгүй шипр үнэр (Cologne). Эхний ноот: бергамот, нероли; зүрхний ноот: нил цэцэг, сарнай, лаванда; суурь ноот: пачули, хуш мод.
description.en: Note di Colonia I by Acqua di Parma is a Chypre Floral fragrance for women and men. Note di Colonia I was launched in 2016. Top notes are Bergamot and Neroli; middle notes are Violet, Damask Rose and Lavender; base notes are Patchouli and Cedar.
